versions.content: When development error detectio n is enabled for the Wdg module: The Wdg_SetMode function shall check that the parameter Mode is within the allowed range. If this is not the case, the function shall not execute the mode switch but raise development error WDG_E_PARAM_MODE and return with the value E_NOT_OK
